text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. To better understand your condition, have you noticed any specific changes in your bowel habits or appetite recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for confirming those symptoms; the weight loss and night sweats are particularly concerning.
